name: Pilot
ability: Once per day, you may guess a player's character. If you are correct, they die. Otherwise, you permanently lose your ability.
flavor: "Commander, we've pinpointed their location. Are we clear to deploy explosives?"

jinxes.reason: A Pilot can still lose their ability, even if they are, or were, killed by the Vigormortis.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Pilot must make their guesses publicly.
If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Pilot must make their guesses publicly.
The Pilot may not guess a player as the Magician.
The Pilot may not guess a player as the King.
If the Pilot has permanently lost their ability and been preached, they do not regain their ability when the Preacher is drunk, poisoned or dead.
